title: Customer Order Administrator
description:
Customer Order Administrator

Peterborough (Hybrid - 3 days onsite per week)

Pay Rate: 13.49 per hour

Starting August/September 2026

We are currently recruiting for a Customer Order Administrator to join a busy and supportive Customer Order Management team on a 6-month temporary contract based in Peterborough.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous administration, order processing, data entry or other transferable experience would be beneficial.

This role is focused on ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and efficiently while supporting the administration of the full order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Process customer orders accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Manually allocate parts to customer orders using internal systems.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation.
- Support data entry across the order lifecycle, including new customer set-up and credit/debit administration.
- Maintain and cleanse system data, including customer records, pricing and order holds.
- Produce and distribute standard internal reports.
- Carry out general administrative duties, including filing, scanning and document management.
- Identify and escalate issues or exceptions where appropriate.
- Suggest process improvements to support continuous improvement initiatives.

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous administration, order processing, data entry or other transferable experience
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- The ability to work efficiently with structured and repetitive tasks.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage your workload and meet deadlines.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
A place to make a difference

Salary: £27,984 per annum, pro rata (£15.38 per hour)
Location: Peterborough, Hybrid, 2 days from home after successful probation period.
Details: Permanent, part-time position (minimum 15 hours per week) with flexible working hours between 9:00am and 3:00pm. Successful candidates will be required to attend a four-week full-time training programme (Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm) before moving to their contracted part-time hours.

With over 21,000 homes across the country, we're responsible for supporting thousands of customers and their families.

We're proud to build positive, long-lasting relationships that go beyond housing. The work we do improves lives and creates vibrant communities where people of all backgrounds can thrive.

If you pride yourself on delivering the best customer care and want to use your skills to make a positive impact on families and communities, there's a place for you at Accent.

About the role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll manage repair-related enquiries, diagnosing faults and making sure our customers are looked after quickly and effectively. You'll deliver exceptional customer service, balancing their needs with those of our contractors and internal stakeholders, keeping everyone updated throughout the process. Your professionalism, efficiency and empathy means you'll build strong customer satisfaction.

Salary

The spot salary for the Customer Service Advisor post is £27,984 per annum, pro rata (£15.38 per hour) for applicants who fully meet the requirements of the post. If you're still developing some of the skills or experience, you can start at a salary 5% or 10% below the spot rate, with clear support and progression opportunities to reach the full amount.

About you

The essentials
- You'll bring experience from a contact centre environment.
- Proven ability to deliver high-quality customer service through clear, accurate, and empathetic communication.
- Resilient and solutions-focused when handling complex or challenging customer conversations.
- Experienced in accurately recording customer interactions using CRM and bespoke IT systems.

The desirables
- Knowledge of housing maintenance and repairs would support your success in the role.
- Evidence of confidently managing challenging customer situations and achieving positive outcomes.

Interview Process

We want your candidate experience to reflect who we are - a place to grow, a place to thrive, a place to be you.

Stage 1: A Place to Connect
A Teams interview with the hiring manager. You'll learn more about the role and team, and we'll get to know you - your experience, goals, and what you bring.

Planned Days: 16th of September

Stage 2: A Place to Show Your Strengths
You'll be invited to an assessment centre at our Peterborough office. On the day there will be role related assessments and a behavioural/scenario-based interview focused on how you apply your knowledge to real-life situations. You'll be asked to complete a Customer Service Questionnaire in advance.

Planned day: 23rd Septmber and 24th of September at 17:00.

The successful applicant will be subject to pre-employment checks, such as DBS and social media screening, before an offer is confirmed.

A place to build a future

We've got big ambitions and we're looking for people who want to grow with us. Here, you'll have the chance to learn new skills, shape your career, and thrive in a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.

And because we believe great work deserves great rewards, here's what you can look forward to:
Generous time off - 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, an extra day for your birthday, and the option to buy more.
Health & wellbeing support - Cash health plan, Health MOTs, online GP access, gym discounts, and a dedicated volunteering day for a cause you care about.
Financial perks - Car leasing options, salary sacrifice schemes, and exclusive discounts through our benefits platform to help your money go further.
Future-focused benefits - Access to both Defined Contribution and Defined Benefit pension schemes through salary sacrifice, plus life assurance at three times your salary for peace of mind.
Family-friendly policies - Enhanced parental leave, flexible working options, and support for work-life balance.
Career development - From Stepping into Management and Management Essentials training to our Leadership Academy, apprenticeships, and more - we'll help you grow and succeed.

This is more than a job - it's a place where you can make an impact, feel valued, and be rewarded for what you do.

We're Committed to Inclusion

We believe diversity makes us stronger and we're committed to creating a place where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to thrive.

Our recruitment process is designed to be accessible and inclusive, and if you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we'll make it happen.

Because this isn't just a workplace - it's a place to belong.

Please don't delay in submitting your application. Where roles are urgent or we receive a high volume of applications, we may interview and conclude the process prior to any closing date indicated.

Please note candidates must have current eligibility to live and work in the UK, Accent do not currently hold a sponsorship license.

If you're looking for a place you can make a positive difference to society, to our organisation and to your future, apply now.

Recruitment Agencies: We work exclusively with partners on our preferred supplier list (PSL) and do not accept unsolicited CVs or speculative approaches from agencies for this role.

title: Sales Support Administrator
description:
Join the UK's leading independent school sportswear brand.

Schoolblazer has brought genuine innovation to the school apparel market, and our sportswear brand, Limitless, is now the number one sportswear brand in independent schools.

We're looking for an organised and customer-focused Sales Administrator to join our growing team. This is a varied role working closely with customers, our sales team, designers, warehouse and suppliers to help deliver outstanding service to our schools.

At Limitless, we believe sport should be accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Our products are designed specifically for young people, helping to build confidence, encourage participation and support active lifestyles.

As demand for the brand continues to grow, we're expanding our team to support existing customers and help drive future growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day support to our field-based sales team.
- Responding to customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Coordinating artwork and designs with our in-house design team.
- Assisting with the creation and maintenance of school website portals.
- Liaising with suppliers, factories and our warehouse team regarding orders.
- Checking and dispatching teamwear orders.
- Building strong relationships with customers and colleagues across the business.

About You

You'll be someone who:
- Has excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Enjoys delivering great customer service.
- Has strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Can prioritise workloads and work to deadlines.
- Is confident using Excel and Outlook.
- Has previous experience in an office-based administration or customer service role.
- Enjoys working as part of a team.

Full training and ongoing support will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity to join a market-leading brand and develop your career within a growing business.

Location and Working Hours

Our Head Office is in Oundle. A town half-way between Northampton and Peterborough. Hours are 9am - 5pm, Monday - Friday. This is an office-based position

25 days holiday pa, in addition to bank holidays.

Up to 15% of salary bonus opportunity

Workplace pension scheme

Death in service benefit

title: Medical Receptionist/ Administrator
description: Dr Laliwala and Partners are looking for an experienced or quick learner, enthusiastic and patient-focused Medical Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly team at Nightingale Medical Centre. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the practice, providing excellent service to our patients and working closely with our clinical and administrative teams. We are looking for someone who is organised, flexible, a strong team player and able to work effectively in a busy GP practice environment. Previous experience within a GP practice or healthcare setting would be desirable. The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will provide an efficient and professional reception and administrative service to patients and the wider practice team. Main duties will include answering telephone calls, managing appointment requests, responding to patient enquiries, signposting patients to the appropriate service and processing online and electronic requests. The role will also involve updating patient records on SystmOne, processing registrations, data entry and supporting general administrative tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with clinical and non-clinical colleagues to ensure patients receive a helpful, efficient and high-quality service. Flexibility will be required to provide cover at our other practice sites when necessary. Job Description Medical Receptionist / Administrator The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will be responsible for providing a professional, efficient and welcoming service to patients, visitors and colleagues. The post holder will support the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and work closely with both clinical and non-clinical members of the team. The duties and responsibilities of the role will include: Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally, dealing with patient enquiries appropriately and transferring calls when required. Process face-to-face, telephone and online/electronic requests from patients. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system, booking, cancelling and amending appointments as appropriate. Signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional, service or source of support. Respond to enquiries and requests from patients, colleagues and external organisations in a professional and timely manner. Provide a welcoming and helpful reception service to patients and visitors attending the practice. Accurately update and maintain patient healthcare records using SystmOne. Read code information onto patient records where appropriate. Process new patient and temporary patient registrations and ensure relevant information is recorded accurately. Undertake general data entry and administrative duties as required. Process incoming correspondence and direct requests such as Subject Access Requests (SARs), insurance reports, solicitor requests and DVLA forms to the appropriate administrative team. Photocopy, scan and process documentation as required. Manage general patient and practice queries efficiently and appropriately. Support clinical and non-clinical colleagues with general administrative tasks as required. Maintain a clean, tidy and effective reception and working environment. Monitor and maintain the reception area and patient notice boards. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance and data protection requirements at all times. Follow practice policies, procedures and protocols and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment. Work collaboratively as part of the wider practice team and provide support and cover to colleagues when required. Attend practice meetings and undertake relevant training as required. Provide cover at other practice sites when required due to operational needs, staff absence or sickness. The post holder will be expected to demonstrate flexibility and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role as required by the Practice Manager or Partners. This job description is intended as a guide to the main responsibilities of the post and may be reviewed and amended from time to time to reflect the changing needs of the practice.
